reference.title: Fix 19 golangci-lint issues across 10 files
reference.summary: CI flagged 19 lint issues spanning gosec G118/G122/G202, staticcheck QF1012/SA6003/SA9003, and misspell. The fixes were applied in an isolated worktree, then rebased onto a main that had just absorbed the ryan/test-coverage branch (which introduced a few additional lint sites), bringing the suite to make lint clean (0 issues) and make test green (9446 pass / 0 fail). Human checkpoints along the way — 'did a recent merge fix these?', 'which worktree are you in?', 'did you run tests?' — caught real state drift and kept the workflow honest; one subagent edit had broken sparkline_test.go, which was recovered mid-flight. Shipped as PR #317.
